source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Using tepid water, gentle skin care products, keeping nails trimmed short, and applying moisturizer to help manage discomfort","B":"Using hot water during bathing in an effort to help soothe the client's itchy, irritated skin from the jaundice","C":"Fairly few specific skin care interventions actually being helpful for managing this kind of persistent itching sensation","D":"Encouraging the client to scratch vigorously whenever needed in order to relieve the discomfort they are currently experiencing"}}
source_row.rationale: Skin care for jaundice-related pruritus includes using tepid (not hot) water for bathing, gentle skin care products, keeping nails trimmed short to reduce skin damage from scratching, and applying moisturizer, supportive measures to help manage this uncomfortable and common symptom of liver disease.
